Order with signature of Judge and that of parties or

05.01.2026 
Mr. Muhammad Sadiq Khan, Advocate along with the 
petitioner. 
 
 
Through the instant petition, the petitioner seeks 
protective/transitory bail in case FIR No.321, dated 
06.11.2025, offences under section 489-F PPC, P.S. Frere, 
Karachi South.  
2. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner, inter alia, 
contended that on account of the imminent threat of 
arrest at the hands of local police, the petitioner is not 
able to approach the court of competent jurisdiction at 
Karachi East; therefore, he may be granted protective 
bail.  
3. 
In view of above, the petitioner is granted 
transitory/protective bail for two (02) weeks i.e. up-till 
19.01.2026 subject to furnishing bail bonds in the sum of 
Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five thousand only) with 
one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of 
Deputy Registrar (Judicial) of this Court, to enable him 
to approach the court of competent jurisdiction; the 
instant bail shall automatically lapse after the referred 
date. The petitioner may deposit cash surety. 
4. 
The instant petition stands disposed of in the above 
terms. 
 
 
(KHADIM HUSSAIN SOOMRO) 
JUDGE 
Zahid
